name: Multilingual Matrix Rain
description: Full-screen canvas Matrix-style digital rain whose falling streams spell out greetings in many world languages, with flickering digits and a bright head on each column.
contents: Full-viewport black canvas with falling character streams built from multilingual hello-world phrases
behavior: Streams fall at random speeds and wrap to the top
Canvas resizes with the window and rebuilds streams
Animation frame and resize listener are cleaned up on unmount

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the black background and trail fade color

fixed: Canvas is sized to the window, not the container
